runtime_inputs: current and historical HB MoE router probabilities

phenotype_scores.loop: min(percentile(self-normalized late-flow volatility), percentile(self-normalized route acceleration))

primary_evaluation.interpretation: currently at onset or entering a physical Trap within two replanning queries

evaluation_modes.onset_hazard: evaluate only the pre-onset risk set through onset
evaluation_modes.onset_absorbing_proxy: label every query from onset minus H through episode end; this is not an active-duration ground truth

notes: Feature values and direction-specific route states are materialized before onset labels are loaded.
Calibration labels are used only to estimate state-conditional event frequencies; this is calibration, not an unlabeled method.
Target probabilities are written without target labels and evaluated in a separate join step.
The 0.75 threshold is evaluated as proposed, not selected to optimize these corpora.
